title.en: Mistral releases Large 4 model weights after public preview
title.zhHans: Mistral 在公开预览后发布 Large 4 模型权重

searchSummary.en: Mistral released Large 4 weights on October 29; the license requires a separate commercial agreement for some hosted services.
searchSummary.zhHans: Mistral 于 10 月 29 日发布 Large 4 权重；部分托管服务商业使用须另行签约。

summary.en: Mistral released the weights of an updated Mistral Large 4 model on October 29, after its October 6 public preview. Hugging Face documented the hosted model files. The Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License permits many uses but requires a separate commercial license for businesses operating Model-as-a-Service. The available material does not establish the first public-download minute, independent benchmark superiority or measured deployment.
summary.zhHans: Mistral 于 10 月 29 日发布更新版 Mistral Large 4 的权重，此前该模型于 10 月 6 日进入公开预览。Hugging Face 记录了托管模型文件。Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight 许可允许多种使用方式，但运营模型即服务业务的企业须另行取得商业许可。现有材料无法确定公众首次下载的具体时间，也不能证明跑分优势已被独立复现或模型已实际部署。

narrative.en: This node records the transition from a public preview to accessible weights, not a second first launch. The October 29 date comes from the host’s dated article and independent reporting; the repository existed earlier. Company benchmark claims and quoted partner plans are not treated as measured adoption.
narrative.zhHans: 本节点记录的是从公开预览转向权重可用，并非再次首次发布。10 月 29 日依据托管方文章和独立报道；仓库此前已存在。厂商跑分及合作方的计划表述不计作已测量的采用。

text.en: On October 29, 2026, Mistral published improved Large 4 model weights after the October 6 preview, with files documented on Hugging Face.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 10 月 29 日，Mistral 在 10 月 6 日预览之后发布更新版 Large 4 权重，Hugging Face 记录了模型文件。

text.en: The repository license requires businesses operating Model-as-a-Service to obtain a separate Mistral commercial license before commercial use; this is not unrestricted MIT use.
text.zhHans: 仓库许可要求运营模型即服务业务的企业在商业使用前另行取得 Mistral 商业许可，不属于不受限制的 MIT 使用。
